Right now I'm working on a game that helps kids build a stronger vocabulary and reading skills by integrating natural word progression into the core gameplay. It's an RPG where you start off with low level words as your skills like "cut" and "burn", but as you get stronger your words also become more powerful words like "slice" and "ignite" and then into max level words like "lacerate" and "conflagrate".
